# Swarm Market Making — Script Master Labs
# https://www.scriptmasterlabs.com/swarm-market-making.html

> Coordination without custody. Swarm compresses trader intent into maker-style limit levels + venue weights. Users keep their broker and capital.

## Product
- Name: Swarm Market Making (swarm-mm)
- Company: Script Master Labs, LLC (SDVOSB)
- Canonical: https://www.scriptmasterlabs.com/swarm-market-making.html
- Category: FinanceApplication / market microstructure signals
- Not a broker-dealer, ATS, or RIA. Not investment advice.

## Benefits (retail)
- Clear resting limit prices from shared intent
- Venue guidance tilted to maker-rebate style venues
- Rebate / spread estimates before submit
- Broker-native order previews (Alpaca / Tradier / IBKR) — user submits
- Free paper swarm + leaderboard before paying
- No pooled capital on Signal path

## Free portion
- Sim Swarm: $0
- Paper capital, simulated maker limits, leaderboard, upgrade funnel
- Endpoints: POST /v1/sim/join, POST /v1/sim/trade, GET /v1/sim/leaderboard, WS /ws/signals

## Agent pay-per-call
1. Agent calls paid route (e.g. GET /v1/signal/levels)
2. HTTP 402 with accepts[] multi-rail
3. Pay stablecoin
4. Retry with X-PAYMENT / X-Payment-Hash proof
5. Receive ladder JSON

MCP tools: signal_swarm.levels, signal_swarm.venue_map, signal_swarm.rebate_tracker, signal_swarm.broker_orders, sim_swarm.*, b2b_swarm.*, crypto_swarm.*

## Mechanism (short)
1. Intent aggregation
2. Limit ladder around mid
3. Venue weights
4. Signal delivery (HTTP/WS/MCP)
5. User executes at own broker (Variant A)
